title: Schedule of Premiums Returned on the Coverage That Was to Come with a Commissioned Piece
content:
# Schedule of Premiums Returned on the Coverage That Was to Come with a Commissioned Piece

Where a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is closed at the customer's request, premiums already paid on the coverage that was to come with the piece are returned to the customer on the schedule below. What is returned turns on the coverage the customer holds and on the claims settled against it.

| The customer's coverage | Returned |
|---|---|
| Coverage standing in force on which premiums have been paid and against which no claim has been settled | The premiums paid on that coverage in full, that is 100 per cent of them |
| Coverage standing in force on which premiums have been paid and against which a claim has been settled | 50 per cent of those premiums |
| Any other case | Nothing is returned for the coverage that was to come with the piece |

**What the customer has paid toward the coverage, and what has been claimed on it.** Both are held under Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans: what the customer has paid toward the plan so far, and how many claims have been settled on it over its whole life. Coverage stands in force while that plan stands active.

**Where the customer holds no such coverage.** Where no plan of theirs stands active, or nothing has been paid toward it, nothing is returned for the coverage that was to come with the piece.

**A single settled claim is enough to halve the return.** The second line of the schedule turns on whether any claim has been settled, not on how many: one settled claim and four settled claims are answered the same way.

*Hypothetical figures.* On a plan standing active with USD 780.00 paid toward it: with no claim settled on it, USD 780.00 is returned; with one claim settled on it, USD 390.00 is returned; with four claims settled on it, USD 390.00 is returned.
